notes:
DUPLICATE-NAME FLAG - DO NOT MERGE. A second row bearing the name 'Dr. Rajeev Menon' exists elsewhere in this 1,756-row source dataset, attributed to a different hospital. THIS row (1253) is the AIG Hospitals instance, and only AIG-sourced facts have been recorded here. 'Rajeev Menon' is a common Kerala-origin name and there are multiple unrelated Menons in Indian medicine (a 'Mani Menon' and a 'P. Balachandran Menon' both surfaced in results and are different people). The two rows must be kept separate in any downstream deduplication; merging them is a human decision, not an automatic one.

NAME-FORM NOTE: he is indexed variously as 'Dr. Rajeev Menon', 'Dr. Rajeev Vijaykumar Menon' and 'Dr. Rajeev Vijay Kumar Menon' - the same person, confirmed because all forms resolve to Cardiology at AIG Hospitals, Gachibowli, Hyderabad with identical qualifications (MBBS Osmania 1997, MD Gandhi Medical College 2001, DNB Cardiology 2005).

Identity verified on four criteria - name + specialty (Cardiology) + hospital (AIG) + city (Hyderabad/Gachibowli) - agreeing across TWO INDEPENDENT OFFICIAL sources: (1) aighospitals.com, the hospital's own site, which returned a per-doctor page for him at https://aighospitals.com/doctors/dr-rajeev-menon, reinforced by AIG's own official Facebook page naming him 'Consultant Cardiologist, AIG Hospitals'; (2) healinindia.gov.in, the Government of India's Advantage Healthcare directory, listing him as 'Dr. Rajeev Menon - Cardiology in AIG Hospitals'. A .gov.in registry is independent of the hospital, so the High band is properly earned. Credihealth, Skedoc, Sehat, HexaHealth and CardiologistIndia are corroborating only and were not counted toward the band.

AIG URL note: his page uses the PLURAL /doctors/<slug> family rather than the singular /doctor/<slug> used by most AIG doctors in this batch - recorded exactly as returned, not normalised. A related AIG URL, https://aighospitals.com/doctors/dr-rajeev-vijay-kumar-menon/attachment/dr-rajeev-vijay-kumar-menon-3, was returned but with the title '404 Page Not Found', so it was deliberately NOT recorded; it does however independently show AIG holds pages for him under the fuller 'Rajeev Vijay Kumar Menon' form.

NO email or phone recorded. AIG publishes no per-doctor phone or email, and no published personal contact surfaced in any query. The Facebook items are AIG's own institutional page, not a personal account of his, so they sit in other_profiles rather than the facebook field. A Threads account 'Rajeev Menon (@rmenon73)' surfaced but there was NOTHING tying it to this cardiologist rather than to any other person of that common name, so it was discarded rather than recorded - a human should not assume it is him. No LinkedIn or Practo profile surfaced.
